title: Unctuous Silky Slovakian Chicken Noodles
description: A cultured and silky post-workout Slovakian dish featuring sesame seed oil and flambe, high in protein to aid in muscle recovery.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the egg noodles according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the sesame seed oil over medium-high heat and add the chicken, cooking until browned on all sides and cooked through.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside, then add the sliced onion and cook until caramelized.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the paprika, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the chicken broth to the skillet and bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in the sour cream and cook for an additional 2 minutes, until heated through.
Add the cooked noodles and chicken back to the skillet and toss to combine.
Use a match or lighter to flambe the dish, being careful not to burn the ingredients.
Serve the noodles and chicken hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
